Title: Identity Secure Score in the Azure AD Portal

Body.Content:
Gain visibility and control over your security posture by discovering opportunities that will help to improve security across your organization. These opportunities are surfaced as recommendations, which are coupled with the guidance and the workflows necessary to help security administrators implement each recommendation - all surfaced and actionable within the Azure AD portal. The more improvements you make, the more your identity security posture improves.

Visit the tech community blog to learn more.
